action_scope.definition: Unique action IDs with at least one task marked Completed in any participant table. Repeated takes, error attempts and pending tasks do not add action types.

catalog_source.english_translation: Editorial translation of the original Chinese catalog

normalized_names.operation: Whitespace normalization and literal trailing \n removal only

metric.definition: Sum metadata.duration_s once per unique indexed recording. The publisher measures one RoboCap reference video per segment, or the cropped common interval for aligned-intersection packages. Concurrent camera streams are never added together.
metric.not_equivalent_to: Reviewed usable hours or annotated action-only duration
metric.quality_limitation: Rows without explicit quality fields are retained as indexed recordings; they are not claimed to have passed a new quality audit.
metric.zero_rule: Every action in the selected scope is retained. An action with no contributing indexed recordings has 0 hours.
metric.missing_rule: Null, negative, nonnumeric, NaN, or infinite duration values do not contribute; affected actions are marked partial.
metric.deduplication: First (primitive_id, session_id), then identical reference-video Git blob fingerprints across all included segments when a tree snapshot is supplied; retain the latest package.
metric.fault_rule: Use only the normal dataset index; exclude explicit error/fault/failed/invalid/rejected quality status, fault target/path, or nonempty error_types.
metric.annotation_policy: No annotation trimming or multiplication by episode count is applied.
